notes: Linux ScopedOwnedTasksV1: the native adapter waits for the actual worker body and completion-record write before creation returns to the parent. Parent read/drop of the moved Buffer before join reject at Q600 despite worker completion. The accepted control joins, consumes the owned Result and drops the original generation. Exact pointers and join-before-reclamation checks retain the allocation and environment while completed but unjoined. This is one owned Buffer, not loan/share restoration or a general scheduler proof.
